root_cause: In the directional selected union replay, all 47 protective signal days immediately recycled proceeds into other stocks and restored total target exposure to 1.0. Local name stops were not portfolio de-risking.
hypothesis: Require fresh stock-level breakouts for new money, stop reallocating on a protective exit close, retain intact units without scheduled ranking replacements, and use a confirmed slow-trend break in addition to a peak stop. This separates real risk reduction from substitution into stale long-momentum names.

fixed_rules.rank: mean trailing log returns over 30,60,120 sessions with causal since-observed fallback
fixed_rules.entry: fresh prior-window closing high, positive rank, close above slow mean
fixed_rules.exit: observed peak drawdown or two consecutive closes below slow mean; stale quote closes risk
fixed_rules.allocation: retain intact units; initial entry cap 0.6 except singleton; drift cap 0.8 except singleton; use only cash; on any protective exit signal do not recycle its proceeds on that close

selection_objective: mean(log(wealth / matched buy_hold wealth) - 0.75 * max_drawdown - 0.002 * max(0, orders_per_year - 20))
execution: Unchanged parent next-session engine and all costs/capacity assumptions. No intraday or same-close stop fills.
limitations: All inspected periods remain retrospective. Preserve the complete directional trial ledger and all new trials. Do not call finite-subset checks universal dominance.
